verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Lifecycle Workflows whose processes 'run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle', and automatic SCIM provisioning. Both are event- or lifecycle-triggered automation, and no evidence documents a user-defined recurring schedule for jobs or workflows. Trigger-based automation is an adjacent capability and cannot stand in for recurring scheduling, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
